mapper.select: SELECT BS.SCENE_NODE_ID id, CASE BS.FSCENE_NODEID WHEN NULL THEN #{fNodeId} ELSE IFNULL(BT.TABLE_NAME, SDL.ITEM_VALUE) END AS text, "LEVEL" as col FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG BS LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLELIST BT ON BS.NODE_VALUE = BT.TABLE_ID and BS.NODE_ID = 'ACCOUNTEVENTS' LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BTD ON BS.NODE_ID = BTD.DICT_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL ON SDL.DICT_CODE = BTD.DICT_SOURCE AND SDL.ITEM_CODE = BS.NODE_VALUE WHERE BS.SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId} ORDER BY BS.SCENE_NODE_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
1 AS isExtends,
CASE BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID WHEN #{sceneNodeId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isExtends,
BSS.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectId, concat_ws('',IFNULL(BSU.SUBJECT_NAME,''),'（',BSU.SUBJECT_NO,'）') AS subjectName, BSS.FORM_ELE AS formEle, BT.DICT_NAME AS dictName, BSS.CD_FLAG cdFlag, BSS.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, BSS.ACCOUNT_NET accountNet FROM BOK_SCENESUBJECT BSS LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT BSU ON BSS.SUBJECT_NO = BSU.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BT ON BT.DICT_ID = BSS.FORM_ELE AND BT.DICT_TYPE = #{DATA_TYPEN} WHERE INSTR(#{sceneNodeId}, BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID) = 1 ) de ORDER BY isExtends DESC

SELECT SUBJECT_NO AS id, concat_ws('',IFNULL(SUBJECT_NAME,'') , '（' ,SUBJECT_NO , '）' ) AS text, BAL_FLAG AS col, SUBJECT_TYPE AS parentId FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS1 WHERE BS1.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS WHERE BS.FSUBJECT_ID = BS1.SUBJECT_NO )

SELECT CASE de.fSceneNodeId WHEN NULL THEN 1 ELSE CAST(de.fSceneNodeId AS SIGNED INTEGER) + 1 END FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING(MAX(SCENE_NODE_ID) , LENGTH(FSCENE_NODEID) + 1) fSceneNodeId FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE 1=1
AND FSCENE_NODEID = #{fsceneNodeid}
AND FSCENE_NODEID is null
GROUP BY FSCENE_NODEID ) de
